_about: T. W. Allen (1862-1950), Fellow of Queen's College, Oxford, editor of the Oxford Homer, raw IA OCR: Notes on Abbreviations in Greek Manuscripts (Clarendon Press, MDCCCLXXXIX = 1889); The Homeric Catalogue of Ships, edited with a commentary (Clarendon Press, MDCCCCXXI = 1921). His Homeric Hymns with Sikes (1904) is on the e-e-sikes shelf. Greek-dense volumes kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dx). No uids minted.
